node.statement: FLOOR RE-POSE (2026-07-07, floor campaign): this node was already floor-shaped (created 2026-07-06 as the weakest x4 premise; consumer sufficiency proved at 16n^3). Now framed as a standing conjecture with the pre-registered falsifier below. DOC CORRECTION BANKED: x4's statement.md prose still prints the stale n^2 primitive target and names u1_pullback_dichotomy — the DAG edge and this n^3 form are authoritative. Opening evidence: budget probe PASS at 1.5% of budget with positive control detected. | At the official X4/list corridor rows, after quotient, dihedral, moment-trade, U2 boundary, and DLI/skew strips have removed their paid columns, the remaining primitive exact-list active-core residue fits inside the direct row column consumed by x4_exactlist_staircase_split. A sufficient concrete target is <= n^3 at the official rows. This is strictly weaker than u1_pullback_dichotomy: it does not classify every canonical trade into a pullback dictionary and does not require the older orbit-converted n^2 survivor bound. | SURVIVAL +1 scoped (2026-07-07, F3-A1): boundary sweep with exact instrument gate (positive control 60 trades) — zero nontoral trades, zero n^3 alarms at 11 rows incl. FULL-window versions of the previously sliced boundary rows and extended primes 3137/12289; n=64 rows clean-but-partial, queued for anchor-sharded F3-A1b. | SURVIVAL +3 -> **HARDENED** (2026-07-07, F3-A2): adversarially smooth q (incl. Fermat 65537) zero trades at full windows; exceptional structure confined to the tiny-field window (zero at p >= 97). Families: boundary sweep / smooth-q engineering / exceptional confinement. Remaining follow-up: n=64 full windows (numpy rewrite). | SURVIVAL +4 (2026-07-07, Pro floor-window 3): independent Pro anchored-PTE probe — gate reproduced exactly, all banked rows re-verified, and our open n=64 flank EXTENDED (complete exact h=5,6 sweeps at the first four primes above n^2: zero non-toral hits). Remaining flank by both sides' accounting: n=64, h >= 7. || FLIP-CHAIN ADDENDUM (2026-07-09, overnight flip branch integrated at merge daa30d2): h=3 obligation provably reduced (f3_h3_officialrow_conditional_close) to two named gates — conic rank deficit (Delta <= 2899 via kernel-bundle splitting, margin 52 of slack in the balanced form) + bridge rank-capacity (Z_4096_floor units) — under the official-row retarget H3-ACT(4096) (n = 2^s kills the toral term). Independent backup lanes: moment program (six star gates + M-bound), private-linear alternate (Delta <= 25). Remaining for the red beyond h=3: h=5 n=64 certificate completion, h=8 residual certification, h-ladder coverage audit. | WP3 KERNEL-BASIS VERDICT (2026-07-10, notes/kernel_basis/WP3_WP4_VERDICT.md): REDUCTION-PARTIAL onto K2 — Face 1 CONSUMES this node (TR per-leaf ~ quotient-row x4+u1: the same open clause-(ii) instance, a unification datum); missing X1-X6 incl. CATCH #26: the U2 moment-trade window '(t, polylog n]' is over-broad — FM covers only b <= t log2(q)/log2(n) (fails from b=10 at s=41, exact); on the gap window the operating point is not FM-suppressed and K2 grants nothing. Simplification: the absolute n^3 budget kills the M6 constant problem at FM-suppressed strata. || QUALITY CERT (2026-07-10, red-quality program): critical/nodes/u1_x4_direct_column_budget/QUALITY.md || BAND PIN (2026-07-10, derivation audit resolving catch #38): the direct column's obligation ranges over active-core widths 2 <= h <= H_max(row) = min(A(row), floor(n/2)), A = k+t — PROVED outer pin (star_pte_support_bound: full trades occupy (t, A], both edges realized at F_101; star-PTE injectivity bounds the list residue by band trades; h_window_derivation had already adjudicated H_max := A for the previous consumer). ALL THREE circulating candidates are STRUCK as non-inherited artifacts: prose h <= 8 (= the probe rows' range and, coincidentally, the s=13 first-moment vacancy threshold — heuristic, row-dependent (rises to 16 at s=41), and model-violated in-range by SP-CENSUS-2 norm-gate mass); m720's 7..20 (scannability edge of an archived lane); the refs' (log2 n)^2 (frozen W3 v1 grammar window — wrong in BOTH directions: over-covers Row C 1/16, under-covers prize rows by ~2^30). INTERIOR: OPEN — no proved per-h cap exists for h >= 4 (the fiber cap explodes: cap(4) = n^3 x 2^18 at s=13); the h!-decay is unproved Poisson heuristic. Named lemma minted: f3_active_core_width_cap (ev-wired) — absent it the uniform-in-h gate shape is FORCED. Exact ledger correction (catch #48): h=3 ACT(4096) spend = 50.0002% of n^3 (banked '50.002%' was a transcription slip; = (4096 + 1/72)/8192 exactly); h=2 CP spend 0.7366%; remainder 49.263% for the whole h >= 4 band (~519..4095 strata at s=13; ~2^40 strata at prize rows); under n^3 there is room for exactly ONE ACT(4096)-grade stratum. Arithmetic: notes/band_hband_arithmetic_20260710.py (replayed exact). || U16 RE-POSE + AMBER (2026-07-10; Codex worktree proposal ecf84fc, audited fresh-context — verdict AMBER-READY with amendments A1-A5, all applied; catches #71-#75): the node's posed floor is the CONSUMER'S TRUE FORM R_post < 16n^3 at the official corridor rows (consumer allowance non-strict <= 16n^3; poly-forcing 52/52 + QA.22 27/27 at the six decision candidates; A1 PIN: the consumer gate table is PROVED at the six clean-rate candidates — the 29-row gate table is an OWED artifact, catch #75, and U16's row set is pinned to the proved candidate grid until it lands). The former <= n^3 headline is retained as a stronger historical target/evidence line. ROUTE OF RECORD (U-PART, machine-verified assembly + 2 mutation controls): R_post = R_1 + R_2 + R_3 + Sigma_{h>=4} R_h over the proved band (KB #27) with payments R_1 = 0 (f3_h1_singleton_injectivity, PROVED) + R_2 < n^3 (f3_h2_stratum_theorem at all 29 rows; catch #72: the in-house K6 chain — E <= 211n^(5/2), T_2 <= (211/8)n^(5/2) < n^3 for n > 695 — imported and cited alongside the CP constant, dissolving the import caveat) + R_3 < n^3 (f3_h3_direct_floor_conditional_close, CONDITIONAL on C36') + Sigma_{h>=4} <= 14n^3 (f3_hge4_aggregate_budget) = strictly < 16n^3. The old h=3 route (f3_h3_officialrow_conditional_close + conic/rankcap gates) stays the ALTERNATE (ev); f3_active_core_width_cap stays ev (route-1 evidence for HGE4). RE-SURGERY (demote to TARGET) if: C36' falsified at an official row; HGE4-14 falsified under slice semantics; the band pin changes; the consumer's 16n^3 allowance moves (QA.22 conventions / #493 re-attribution); the A1 29-row table fails at any intermediate row; or the F-4 minimal-trade convention re-opens. Optional tightening: a proved strip paying the {P,-P} class restores the 8n^(4/3) threshold.
